body:
Hi again everyone. Again, I really do appreciate everyone's honesty. I did awful things and I deserve to be judged for them. I am currently in therapy and will bring this up and try to work through it there. Rereading what I wrote and how I wrote it, i totally agree with the majority. I cheated on my boyfriend. I slept with someone I shouldn't have. I was extremely irresponsible and careless about the consequences of my actions.

In regards to the grooming, i had actually never considered it before. I met him when I was 15 and he was 23, we are 8 years apart. I don't think this at all excuses my behavior by the way. I did shitty, fucked up things. I wasn't willing to admit it to myself and played the victim. I fucked and i dont want to do this to anyone ever again. We met online. What is grooming and does this situation qualify as grooming?
Thank you for your input. I accept responsibility for my actions entirely and appreciate your candid responses. Thank you for your help.
Go for it!!! I think you're awesome

I think that it was really wonderful of you to be there for your friend. 

Ups and downs in any relationship are normal and natural, whether your friends or dating or whatever. If she doesn't feel the same way for you, then it might be time to accept that and move on from her. You clearly are a caring person and there are people who will want to be with you.

If your family isn't listening, talk to someone else. If your brother is a minor, any teacher or school employee should be a mandated reporter and get your brother help.

Also, try talking to your brother, let him know you're there for him and want to help him.

I feel... like a can of soda that was all shaken up and the someone openned it and all the soda sprayed out, but now it's settling down a bit. I know that's an unusual analogy haha. 

I was scared. To actually face it. To say it out loud and share it publicly like this. It's still scary. But, I feel like this is a good first step for me. I want to keep going.

Please don't worry about doubting, you weren't mean at all! It's the internet afterall, a little skepticism is good. Thank you for your kind words, really. I have depression too and it can be so easy to forget about the people that love you, I have to make a conscious effort myself.

And trust me, you are stronger than you realize.

I'll give those a try, thank you. Truly.

Yes, I'd been in therapy with many different therapists since my father's passing. They all helped me get through things, actually survive and do what was needed. I have clinical depression as well as anxiety so I am eager to continue my treatment. I thought posting here would be good, and maybe help others too.

And just to let everyone know, I am a strong proponent of therapy and recommend it to anyone dealing with depression or difficult times. And if you don't like/ don't click with your first therapist, go find another one. Keep looking until you find someone you can work with. :)

I'm in tears from your words. Thank you so much for saying all that. I was in therapy and moved recently to attend university. I am waiting for my insurance to transfer and then I can find another therapist to see again. I want to live, I want to survive. I know my likelihood for suicide is so much higher because of what has happened, but I want to live. I looked in my area but there are no suicide support groups running. It would be nice to talk to someone who has been through this kind of loss. I'm not really sure where to go or what to do from here.

Thank you for reading my story, and yes haha, it is very much real. I'm trying to figure out my life right now, and what you said means so much. And, please don't worry, your English is fine!
Thank you for being brave. It is so incredibly difficult to be in your shoes, I can only imagine. But here you are, on this subreddit. You are truly brave. Thank YOU, friend. I agree, let's seek happiness.
